items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 123:1
items.html: (To the question) What is Zion? The Yesod of the Nukva, which is the aspect of the Tzadik that comes out of her, as above in Answer 121, is called by the name Zion. And it is from the language of going out, namely, named after the Tzadik that comes out of her. See there. (Item 70).
